dependency_simplification:
DRIFT / REUSE: this turn closes the main analytic path gap rather than
adding another abstract-label helper. The omitted-time estimate imports the
original indicatrix theorem; compact interval covers use mathlib's measure
construction; countable branches use measure continuity; and local affine
neighborhoods use mathlib countable subcovers and enumeration. The finite-prefix
limit argument was factored into one shared lemma for both the quantitative
obstruction and full constructive path labeling statement. Neither a general
area formula nor a countable first-return measure was developed. No restrictions
on the original final path endpoint were added. Native and approximation
consequences remain explicitly open, so this is not a fifth completed family.
